topic.title: AI for Productivity
topic.description: Use AI tools to automate workflows, write faster, and ship more.

items.prompt: What is the BEST way to think about AI in your workflow?
options: A magic oracle that's always right
A toy with no real business value
A multiplier on the skills you already have, not a replacement for thinking

items.prompt: Which workflow benefits the MOST from AI assistance?
options: Tasks with a blank-page problem — emails, outlines, first drafts, brainstorming
Tasks where you already know the exact answer
Tasks requiring emotional intelligence with people

items.prompt: What is the 'AI-first' workflow approach?
options: Replace all human collaboration with AI
Use AI for every single decision in your life
Default to asking AI before doing routine knowledge work manually, then refine the output
Never use AI for any work

items.prompt: Which mindset SLOWS down AI productivity gains?
options: Sharing context generously with the AI
Treating AI output as a draft to refine
Demanding the first output be perfect instead of iterating quickly

items.prompt: What's a TRUE statement about AI's impact on productivity?
options: Gains are highly task-dependent — some tasks see 5x speedup, others see no improvement
It speeds up every task uniformly
It only helps with coding tasks

items.prompt: What's the MOST effective way to use AI for writing?
options: Have AI write the final version with no edits
Type 'write something good' and ship the output
Provide context, audience, tone, and length — then edit the AI's draft heavily
Copy AI output without reading it

items.prompt: Which task is AI ESPECIALLY good at for writers?
options: Predicting which post will go viral
Verifying obscure historical facts without sources
Generating headline variations, outlines, and rewrites in different tones
Capturing your unique authentic voice without examples

items.prompt: How can you make AI sound MORE like YOU?
options: Show it 2-3 examples of your past writing and say 'match this tone and style'
Trust that AI knows your voice automatically

items.prompt: What's a PITFALL of AI-written marketing copy?
options: It uses too many emojis automatically
It often sounds generic and full of clichés if not heavily prompted and edited
It refuses to write any copy

items.prompt: Which is a SMART use of AI for long-form content?
options: Generate an outline first, then expand each section, then unify the voice in a final pass
Write the whole thing yourself then ask AI to summarize
Never use AI for long content
Generate the entire 5000-word article in one prompt and publish

items.prompt: What's a high-leverage use of AI for email?
options: Drafting replies to common requests, summarizing long threads, and suggesting tone adjustments
Replying without reading the incoming email

items.prompt: Before sending an AI-drafted email, what should you ALWAYS do?
options: Read it carefully — AI may add details, names, or commitments that aren't accurate

items.prompt: Which AI feature helps make emails sound MORE professional?
options: Tone adjustment prompts like 'rewrite this in a more formal, polite, concise tone'

items.prompt: What's a GREAT prompt structure for an AI email assistant?
options: 'Reply to this email. Tone: friendly but professional. Length: 3 sentences. Goal: politely decline and suggest next week.'

items.prompt: When should you AVOID using AI for email?
options: Highly personal, condolence, or sensitive interpersonal messages where authenticity matters

items.prompt: What's the BEST way to use AI coding assistants?
options: Only use AI for boilerplate, never for logic
Generate code and ship to production without review
Refuse to use any AI for coding
Pair-programming style — generate code, review it carefully, test it, never blindly accept

items.prompt: Which coding task does AI handle EXCEPTIONALLY well?
options: Novel algorithm design with no precedent
Boilerplate, format conversions, simple refactors, repetitive transformations

items.prompt: What's a SECURITY risk of AI-generated code?
options: AI may suggest deprecated, insecure, or vulnerable patterns it learned from old training data
AI code has too many comments

items.prompt: Which is a HEALTHY workflow with AI coding tools?
options: Disable code review for AI commits
Use AI to draft, understand every line, test thoroughly, then commit with attribution if required
Never write tests for AI code

items.prompt: What is 'vibe coding'?
options: A casual style where you describe the goal in natural language and iterate with AI on the result

items.prompt: What's a SMART way to use AI to learn a new topic?
options: Have AI take exams for you
Ask AI to explain concepts in multiple ways, then verify key facts against authoritative sources

items.prompt: How can AI help you DEEPLY understand a complex topic?
options: Ask it to use analogies, give simpler explanations, then explain why those analogies break down
Ask one question and stop there

items.prompt: What is the 'Feynman technique' enhanced by AI?
options: Explain a concept aloud in your own words, then have AI critique your explanation for gaps
Have AI explain everything to you with no participation

items.prompt: What's a GOOD AI prompt for research?
options: 'Summarize the main arguments for and against X, then list the strongest counterpoints to each.'

items.prompt: What should you NEVER do with AI for academic work?
options: Use AI to brainstorm topic ideas
Use AI to explain a confusing concept
Use AI to check grammar in your draft
Submit AI-generated content as your own original work in violation of academic integrity policies

items.prompt: What can AI meeting note-takers do?
options: Schedule the meetings on your calendar
Transcribe audio, produce summaries, extract action items and decisions, identify speakers

items.prompt: What's a PRIVACY consideration with AI meeting tools?
options: All participants should know recording is happening — disclosure is legally required in many regions
Privacy doesn't apply to virtual meetings
Only the host needs to consent

items.prompt: Which is a HIGH-VALUE post-meeting AI workflow?
options: Replay the entire recording for everyone
Generate summary → extract action items → assign owners → auto-draft follow-up email

items.prompt: How can AI help you PREPARE for a meeting?
options: Summarize prior meeting notes, draft an agenda, prep talking points based on attendees and goals

items.prompt: What's a TRAP of relying on AI meeting summaries?
options: AI may misattribute statements, miss nuance, or hallucinate details — review summaries before acting on them

items.prompt: How can AI help with spreadsheet work?
options: Delete data you no longer need
Generate formulas from natural language, clean data, explain unfamiliar formulas, suggest pivot tables

items.prompt: What's a GOOD prompt for AI spreadsheet help?
options: 'Write an Excel formula that returns the average of column B where column A equals "Lahore".'

items.prompt: How can AI help CLEAN messy data?
options: Encrypt the data so nobody can read it
Delete all the data without asking
Standardize formats, detect duplicates, fill missing values intelligently, normalize text

items.prompt: Which is a SAFE practice with AI and sensitive spreadsheets?
options: Redact or anonymize sensitive columns before uploading to a third-party AI
Upload all customer data to any free AI tool

items.prompt: What CAN'T AI do reliably with numeric data?
options: Precise calculations on large numbers without a calculator tool — it predicts digits, not computes them

items.prompt: What can AI presentation tools (Gamma, Beautiful.ai) do?
options: Generate full slide decks from a topic or outline, with layouts, content, and images

items.prompt: What's a GOOD prompt for an AI slide generator?
options: '10-slide pitch deck for a Pakistani Edtech startup targeting university students. Include problem, solution, market, traction.'

items.prompt: What's a CONTENT trap with AI-generated slides?
options: Too much text per slide — AI defaults to verbose; great presentations are visual

items.prompt: How can AI help with REHEARSING a talk?
options: Generate likely audience questions, suggest counterarguments, simulate Q&A scenarios

items.prompt: What's the BEST division of labor for an AI-assisted talk?
options: AI generates first draft and visuals; you bring stories, insights, voice, and live delivery

items.prompt: What is a 'no-code AI workflow' platform?
options: Tools like Make.com, Zapier, n8n that let you connect apps and AI models without writing code
A platform that disables all code

items.prompt: Which is a CLASSIC no-code AI automation?
options: New form submission → AI analyzes → custom email reply sent automatically

items.prompt: What's a SMART first AI automation to build?
options: Something that solves YOUR own repetitive task — you'll catch bugs faster and feel the value
Something for a client without testing
Something you don't need but looks impressive

items.prompt: What's a COMMON failure mode in no-code AI automations?
options: Silent failures — when an AI step returns weird output and the rest of the workflow blindly continues

items.prompt: How can you DEBUG a complex no-code workflow?
options: Delete and rebuild from scratch every time
Use the platform's run history, log every step's input/output, test with sample data before going live

items.prompt: What can AI image generators (DALL-E, Midjourney, Imagen) do?
options: Create custom illustrations, mockups, product shots, and visual concepts from text descriptions

items.prompt: What's a STRONG image prompt structure?
options: Subject + style + lighting + composition + medium + mood

items.prompt: What's a LIMITATION of current AI image gen?
options: Struggles with consistent characters across multiple images, complex hands, and precise text rendering
Only works in black and white

items.prompt: How can AI help with brand design?
options: Generate color palette options, logo concepts, font pairings, and mood boards quickly

items.prompt: What's an ETHICAL concern with AI-generated images?
options: Images are too cheap to generate
Training data copyright issues and impact on working artists' livelihoods

items.prompt: What's a HIGH-VALUE PM use of AI?
options: Generating task breakdowns, estimating effort, identifying risks, and writing status updates

items.prompt: Which AI workflow helps with sprint planning?
options: AI assigns tasks to team members without their input
AI breaks down a feature into user stories with acceptance criteria, then estimates relative complexity
AI works in isolation from the team

items.prompt: How can AI help write better STATUS UPDATES?
options: Convert raw notes into structured updates with progress, blockers, next steps in audience-appropriate tone
Remove the need for status updates

items.prompt: What's a SMART use of AI for risk management?
options: Ask AI to list potential risks and edge cases for your project plan as a brainstorming partner
Trust AI to predict the future

items.prompt: Which PM task should AI NOT do alone?
options: High-stakes decisions about scope, deadlines, or team changes that affect people's careers and lives

items.prompt: What is a 'prompt library'?
options: A personal or team collection of reusable, tested prompts for recurring tasks
A library that lends books about AI

items.prompt: What's a GOOD format for storing reusable prompts?
options: Versioned text files in a folder or Notion database, with notes on context and example outputs

items.prompt: What is 'prompt chaining'?
options: Using the output of one AI call as input to the next, building multi-step workflows
Chaining prompts to a physical keyboard

items.prompt: Which is a CLASSIC reusable prompt template?
options: 'You are a [role]. Given [input], produce [output] in [format]. Constraints: [list].'

items.prompt: How do you IMPROVE a prompt over time?
options: Rewrite it from scratch every time
Track when it fails, identify the failure mode, refine, and version the new prompt

items.prompt: When should you use a FRONTIER model (GPT-5, Claude Opus, Gemini Ultra)?
options: Complex reasoning, nuanced writing, multi-step tasks where quality outweighs cost

items.prompt: When is a SMALL/FAST model the right choice?
options: Bulk processing, simple classification, real-time chat, on-device use

items.prompt: What's the value of trying MULTIPLE AI models for the same task?
options: Different models have different strengths — comparing reveals which is best for YOUR use case

items.prompt: What is 'model routing' in productivity workflows?
options: Automatically picking different models for different requests based on complexity, cost, and speed needs

items.prompt: Why use an OPEN-SOURCE model (Llama, Mistral, Qwen) instead of paid APIs?
options: Self-hosting for privacy, no per-call cost, and full customization control

items.prompt: Which apps now have NATIVE AI features built in?
options: Notion, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Figma, GitHub — almost every major productivity app

items.prompt: What is a 'browser AI extension'?
options: A browser made entirely by AI
A browser plugin (like Sider, Monica, Merlin) that lets you use AI on ANY webpage

items.prompt: What can AI in your CODE EDITOR do that ChatGPT can't easily?
options: See your entire codebase context and suggest changes inline as you type

items.prompt: What's a key INTEGRATION question for AI tools?
options: Does it have the best logo?
Is it the newest tool released?
Does it have the most features?
Does this tool access my data securely, and what does it do with that data afterward?

items.prompt: What is MCP (Model Context Protocol)?
options: A standard protocol for connecting AI models to tools and data sources (introduced by Anthropic)

items.prompt: How can AI help with CALENDAR management?
options: Cancel all your meetings without asking
Suggest optimal meeting times, draft scheduling messages, summarize your upcoming week

items.prompt: What's a SMART AI prompt for daily planning?
options: 'Here's my task list and meeting schedule. Help me prioritize using the Eisenhower matrix and identify what to drop.'

items.prompt: How can AI help you OVERCOME procrastination?
options: Do the task entirely for you
Hide the task from your view
Break a vague intimidating task into a small concrete next step you can do in 5 minutes
Tell you to stop being lazy

items.prompt: What's a PITFALL of using AI for time management?
options: Spending more time configuring the AI than the AI saves you

items.prompt: Which AI productivity habit COMPOUNDS the most over time?
options: Capturing prompts that worked well and reusing/improving them across similar tasks
Trying every new AI tool weekly

items.prompt: What is 'AI slop'?
options: Low-quality, generic, mass-produced AI-generated content lacking originality or human insight

items.prompt: How can you AVOID producing AI slop?
options: Use only AI and no human input
Generate as much content as possible
Bring real perspective, specific stories, and ruthless editing — never publish AI's first draft raw

items.prompt: What's the RISK of letting AI 'think' for you too much?
options: Skill atrophy — your own analytical and creative abilities can weaken from disuse

items.prompt: Which AI behavior should you watch out for?
options: Confident-sounding hallucinations — convincingly wrong answers presented as facts

items.prompt: What's a healthy weekly AI habit?
options: Review your AI use — what tasks worked well, what didn't, what to automate next, what to take back manually

items.prompt: How can teams share AI productivity gains?
options: Ban AI for the whole team
Force everyone to use the same prompts
Build shared prompt libraries, document AI-assisted workflows, train team on best practices

items.prompt: What is an 'AI usage policy' for teams?
options: A ban on all AI tools
A list of AI tools to install
A written agreement on what data can be shared with AI, how to disclose AI use, and approved tools

items.prompt: How should teams handle DISCLOSURE of AI assistance?
options: Brag about AI use even when minor
Be transparent — note when AI was used heavily in deliverables, especially client-facing work

items.prompt: What's a TEAM ANTI-PATTERN with AI?
options: Some team members use AI heavily while pretending not to, creating uneven quality and trust issues

items.prompt: Which AI feature helps REMOTE teams?
options: Async meeting summaries, translation, async voice-to-text — bridging timezone gaps
Forcing everyone into the same timezone

items.prompt: What should you NEVER paste into a public AI chatbot?
options: Passwords, API keys, customer PII, confidential business data, unreleased code with IP value

items.prompt: Which is a SAFER AI option for confidential work?
options: Enterprise plans with no-training clauses, or self-hosted open-source models

items.prompt: What is 'prompt injection' and why should productivity users care?
options: Malicious input crafted to make AI ignore instructions — risky when AI processes user emails, web pages, or documents

items.prompt: What's a SAFE practice for AI browser extensions?
options: Install every AI extension you see
Audit permissions, prefer extensions with clear privacy policies, disable when not actively in use

items.prompt: What's a GOOD habit for managing AI subscriptions?
options: Periodically audit which AI tools you actually use and cancel the rest — they add up fast

items.prompt: What META-SKILL matters most for long-term AI productivity?
options: Continuous learning — the field changes fast, the tools that win in 2026 won't dominate in 2028

items.prompt: Which AI skill TRANSFERS across tools and models?
options: Clear thinking, structured prompts, evaluation skills, knowing your own workflow well
Knowing one specific UI by muscle memory

items.prompt: What's the RIGHT mindset toward AI replacing tasks?
options: Compete with AI on its strengths
Move up the value chain — let AI handle the tasks; you focus on judgment, strategy, and human connection

items.prompt: How should you evaluate a NEW AI tool to adopt?
options: Adopt instantly based on Twitter hype
Test on your real tasks for a week, measure time saved, evaluate quality, then decide

items.prompt: What's an UNDERRATED AI productivity skill?
options: Knowing when NOT to use AI — for tasks where human attention, presence, or originality matters most

items.prompt: What's a GOOD first step to build your AI workflow?
options: Buy every AI tool on the market
Identify the 3 most repetitive tasks in your week — those are your highest-leverage AI targets
Replace your job with AI immediately

items.prompt: How do you MEASURE if AI is actually helping you?
options: Track time spent on key tasks before and after; note quality changes and energy/stress levels
Compare yourself to social media posts

items.prompt: What's a SUSTAINABLE AI adoption pace?
options: Add one new tool/workflow at a time, master it, then add the next — avoid context-switching overload

items.prompt: How should you SHARE your AI workflow with others?
options: Demand others use your exact setup
Document with examples and screenshots, teach in small sessions, encourage adaptation not copying

items.prompt: What's the END GOAL of AI productivity?
options: More time and energy for the work and relationships that actually matter to you
